Just How Big Is ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’? The Multibillion-Dollar Frenzy in Charts

The long-awaited videogame is poised to be a cash cow, even compared with the Olympics and Taylor Swift

By

and

The biggest entertainment release of the year—and possibly of all time—is here.

“Grand Theft Auto VI” is widely expected to have the biggest-ever launch for a videogame, projected to sell more than 30 million copies by the end of its publisher’s fiscal year in March, according to third-party analysts. At $80 or more per copy, that is billions of dollars in sales for retailers and revenue for Take-Two Interactive TTWO -3.67 % decrease; down pointing triangle, the parent company of publisher Rockstar Games.
